sql: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, side, quantity, quantity_fp, avg_price FROM positions WHERE captured_at >= now() - interval '3 days' ORDER BY market_ticker, captured_at DESC) SELECT s.market_ticker, to_char(s.captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') cap, s.side, s.quantity, s.quantity_fp, s.avg_price, (SELECT string_agg(o.strategy||':'||o.side||':'||o.action||':'||o.status||'@'||to_char(o.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI'), ', ' ORDER BY o.created_at) FROM live_orders o WHERE o.market_ticker=s.market_ticker) AS orders FROM s WHERE coalesce(s.quantity_fp, s.quantity) <> 0 ORDER BY s.captured_at DESC
